_descriptions.RoboRepo: telemetry session start: Records local token and tool-usage evidence when a session starts or resumes.
_descriptions.RoboRepo: telemetry before tool use: Records local usage evidence before a tool runs, so activity before the tool call remains observable.
_descriptions.RoboRepo: telemetry after tool use: Records local token and tool-usage evidence after a tool finishes.
_descriptions.RoboRepo: telemetry prompt submitted: Records local usage evidence when you submit a prompt.
_descriptions.RoboRepo: telemetry response complete: Records local usage evidence when the assistant finishes a response.
